reply_text:
I told Dana in her direct message that her dock for Tamsin Cold Chain pickups is Dock 38, as she told me on Oct 14. Nothing since then changes it.

I couldn't get it back from the note I saved in gbrain yesterday. gbrain refused the lookup because this connection isn't tied to any one member, so nothing was read. Instead I read Dana's own direct-message history with me, which she can see herself.

To make saved notes retrievable, whoever runs the gbrain server needs to tie this connection to a member. gbrain suggests running `gbrain auth rescope --token <token> --member '<MEMBER>'` on that machine.
